name: LocalTrader price-manager missing access control
summary: The LocalTrader price-manager proxy left storeConstructor unprotected, so anyone could overwrite its feed, admin, owner and LCT price. The attacker took ownership, set the price to 1 wei, bought the exchange's whole LCT inventory for a negligible BNB payment and dumped it into the LCT/WBNB pool.
notes: storeConstructor overwrote the feed, admin, owner and price slots in the anchor itself, so earlier admin and price changes on the proxy do not reset the age; the proxy's deployment does.
The LCT taken from the exchange and dumped into the LCT/WBNB pair is valued at the BNB the dump realised (rule 12): the sale took about 40% of the pair's WBNB, far below LCT's pre-dump mark.
